content: Customer Samar Ghosh initiated a life insurance claim for policy LC-2026-00123 and requested the necessary claim form, document requirements, and submission address. Insurance agent Sunita Agarwal responded by providing the claim form, a document checklist, submission instructions (via email or post), and noted that processing takes 15 business days.

action_items: Customer to complete and submit the claim form along with required documents via email or post
Insurance agency to process the claim within 15 business days upon receipt
